subject: physics_2
question_text: What is the colour code for a resistor of resistance 350 MΩ with 5% tolerance?

verification.note: The mark split is INVENTED and is a CLAIM until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it. For this Paper-II bank the two-book union check and the past-paper back-test are STRUCTURALLY IMPOSSIBLE: the TSBIE Basic Learning Material on hand is first-year physics only, and the paper corpus holds only Paper-I papers. Physics hand-checked: 350 MΩ = 350 × 10⁶ Ω = 35 × 10⁷ Ω; 3 = Orange, 5 = Green, 10⁷ = Violet, 5% = Gold; code Orange, Green, Violet, Gold — matches the book.

recall_prompt: Say the steps you would write for this answer, in order. You can speak in English, in Telugu, or in both.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Digits and multiplier
lines: Write the resistance as two digits times a
steps.margin_note: First mark. 350 has three digits, so push one ten into the multiplier: 35 × 10⁷.
steps.why: The code carries only two digit bands. 350 × 10⁶ has three digits, so one factor of ten moves into the multiplier to give 35 × 10⁷.
common_mistakes: Keeping 350 × 10⁶ and running out of digit bands.
Writing 3.5 × 10⁸ — the colour code has only two digit bands, so it needs two whole digits, 35, not 3.5.

recall.must_convey: That 350 mega ohm becomes 35 times 10 power 7 ohm, so the digits are 3 and 5 with multiplier 10 power 7.
accept: shift a ten into the multiplier

steps.memory_tip: Three digits will not fit — slide the extra zero into the power: 35 × 10⁷.

steps.label: The four-band code

lines.text: Colour code: Orange, Green, Violet, Gold

steps.margin_note: Second mark. All four bands, in order, including Gold for 5%.
steps.why: The first three bands re-use the digit table (3 Orange, 5 Green, 7 Violet); the tolerance has its own two-colour rule, Gold 5% and Silver 10%.
common_mistakes: Forgetting the Gold band — the question asks for the 5% tolerance too.
Swapping Gold and Silver: Gold is 5%, Silver is 10%.

recall.must_convey: That the four bands are orange, green, violet, gold — with gold standing for the 5 percent tolerance.

steps.memory_tip: Digits 3-5-7 read Orange-Green-Violet; Gold closes the code at 5%.

insider_note: The reshaping step 350 × 10⁶ → 35 × 10⁷ is where this question is really tested — the colours follow from the table.
